digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and datetime/async compliance
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in global configuration and gate across both src/rebar and tests directories with zero diagnostics.

All datetime objects must use explicit timezone arguments; epoch seconds convert via datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, tz=datetime.timezone.utc) and persisted timestamp strings assign UTC via strptime().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).

Security-pin cadence logic must obtain the current instant as a timezone-aware datetime, convert it to host-local timezone, and extract the local calendar date using datetime.now(tz=...).astimezone().date().
The literal token datetime.UTC is prohibited in production code under src/rebar because the Ruff target-version is py310; all UTC construction must use datetime.timezone.utc.
Validation timestamp clustering must produce identical UTC hour keys across multiple TZ environment values on POSIX/macOS platforms where time.tzset() is available.
